nodes.label: Lúmen Main Logo (Hexagonal)
nodes.rationale: The Lúmen logo uses a hexagonal clip-path — six-sided, like a crystal or carbon lattice. The letterform 'L' appears in Fira Code monospace inside a teal hexagon, connecting the brand to precision, code, and light (lúmen = unit of luminous flux). Used as the favicon in index.html.
